H02G.fTerm:
INSTALLATION OF ELECTRIC CABLES OR LINES, OR OF COMBINED OPTICAL AND ELECTRIC CABLES OR LINES

Note(s)

  • This subclass covers installation of communication cables or lines, including those comprising a combination of optical and electrical conductors, or of lightning conductors as well as installation of power cables or lines.[6]
  • This subclass does not cover installation of purely optical cables, which is covered by group G02B 6/46.
  • In this subclass, the following expression is used with the meaning indicated:
    • "electric cable" includes cables comprising optical conductors, e.g. fibres, in combination with electrical conductors.
